notes: After the person allowed it, what the asking device hands on, locked with a key from the two one-time keys (contract/crypto/check.json): UTF-8 JSON {"root": the root it trusts, or null; "person": {"public_key", "private_key"}, the person's key pair, for a device of its person}. Only the waiting side opens it; a device takes the person's key from there and seals it for itself (POST /api/keys/grants), and adopts the root. Only from the device that asks, after its reveal, once: 409 not_answered otherwise. 400 bad_request for an empty one, or one over 1 KiB.
